The vaccine record is official and may be submitted to child care centers, schools, camps and employers. [...] ## New Residents

If you or your child were not born in the city, your provider will need a copy of the immunization history to add to the CIR record. You should contact your or your child's previous health care provider, or the last school you or your child attended, for your immunization records. The state where you previously lived may also have your records in its immunization registry. [...] Immunization records are for people born in NYC after 1995 and records for adults who consent to have their vaccinations reported by their health care provider. Providers in NYC must report all COVID-19 and flu vaccinations to the Health Department.
